question: From whom must this teaching always be concealed according to the instruction?
premises: The presence of the beast-like and deluded is specified
inference: This teaching must never be revealed in the presence of the bound and deluded.
uncertainties: paśu and pāmara are technical/loaded terms; glossed functionally here.
plain_english: O fair one, it must always be concealed in the presence of the beast-like and the deluded.
